QuestInfo.name: [Home] A Competitive Interview Process
QuestInfo.0: Swanson, the general manager of Gold Beach Resort, arrived at the cafe. Talk to him to find out what's going on.
QuestInfo.1:
It seems Amy's got a number of applicants for her barista position. There's Swanson, the general manager of Gold Beach Resort, Hallowkitty, the owner of Hallows Disco.
and Jenny, who actually has 10 years of experience as a bartender and barista!

After a series of grueling interviews, Jenny was selected for the job. Go to the town square and deliver the good news to her.
QuestInfo.2: The long-awaited day is finally here: the grand opening of Amy's first cafe!

default.0: #h0#... You'll deliver the news, won't you? Great, I'm counting on you!
